body.statement: For \(u\in\{0,1,2\}\), establish foldwise conditional nuisance bounds \(\max_{1\le\ell\le L}\sup_{\theta\in\Theta}\|E_P[\partial_\theta^u\{\widehat v_\theta^{(-\ell)}(O)-v_\theta(O)\}\mid\text{training complement}]\|\le C_{\mathrm{sm}}r_{m,n}r_{e,n}\) and \(\max_{1\le\ell\le L}\sup_{\theta\in\Theta}\|\partial_\theta^u\{\widehat v_\theta^{(-\ell)}-v_\theta\}\|_{P,2}\le C_{\mathrm{sm}}(r_{m,n}+r_{e,n})\). Prove \(\upsilon_n=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\) from uniform foldwise laws and localization, and derive the quantitative replacement template \(\delta_n\le C_{\mathrm{sm}}\{r_{m,n}+r_{e,n}+r_{m,n}r_{e,n}+\upsilon_n\}+o_{\mathbb P}(1)\). It follows that \(\delta_n=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\), equivalently \(\sup_{c\in\mathcal C}n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\|\widetilde\Psi_i(c)-\{\Psi_c(O_i)-\overline\Psi_n(c)\}\|^2=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\), for the fold-specific learned influences evaluated along the same-sample path \(\widehat\theta_c\). Together with the softmax-path entropy lemma, this must yield \(E_\xi[\sup_{c\in\mathcal C}\|n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\xi_i[\widetilde\Psi_i(c)-\{\Psi_c(O_i)-\overline\Psi_n(c)\}]\|\mid O_1,\ldots,O_n]=o_{\mathbb P}(1)\) despite overlapping training complements.
body.justification: The product bound records orthogonal conditional bias, the sum bound records shrinking \(L^2(P)\) diameter, and the explicit path plug-in term isolates what same-sample optimization adds beyond pointwise DML.
body.gap: BelloniChernozhukovChetverikovWei2018 assumes verifiable uniform score approximation conditions; it does not prove the empirical replacement radius for overlapping fold-specific nuisances composed with the same-sample softmax argmax path.
body.consumer: The conditional multiplier theorem and every simultaneous post-selection frontier statement use this replacement bound.
